correctness.rationale: An E1 class realizes a c=2^k vector of color-counts truncated at 2, excluding zero; an E2 class a vector of counts of each inner type truncated at2, excluding zero. Explicit guarded formulas L_t and D_t test >=1,>=2 color in an inner class, P_a and Q_a test >=1,>=2 distinct E1 classes of inner type a in its outer class; nesting gives quantifier ranks up to four and a class-existence defining sentence rank five. A guarded tuple contains at most two E2-related elements (or one), hence its entire guarded back-and-forth behavior is determined by these capped inner and outer multiplicities and global presence set S. This works even for infinite classes because third distinct witnesses are not retained under arity-two guarded moves. The minimum per inner profile is sum_t a_t, per outer profile sum_a b_a w(a), and one outer class of each b in S gives exact μ(S); summing all nonzero b gives sharp maximum c*3^c*3^(3^c-1). Fresh independent exact sums confirmed k=0 number theories 255, size27; k=1 size118098; inspected source independently exercises guarded fixed-point games on 7335 finite pairs (not rerun here). The all-structure statement is justified by back-and-forth, not finite tests.
